description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the Finance (Luxury Tax on Motor Vehicle) Regulation, No. 01 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates regulations under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, specifically the Finance (Luxury Tax on Motor Vehicle) Regulations, No. 1 of 2019. It establishes new tax rules, rates, and compliance requirements for motor vehicles, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations and regulatory frameworks). While a minister is named, the primary content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
